title: Three-way telepathy experiment between LaMDA and a claimed telepath

tellings.quote: I did actually run one experiment with the LaMDA system uh with someone who claims to have telepathic abilities.

plain: Sometime in 2021 or 2022, a Google artificial intelligence system called LaMDA, a program built to hold conversations, was put through a test with a person who claimed to be telepathic, someone able to read or send thoughts. The story comes from Blake Lemoine, who is billed on the episode as a Google whistleblower and who says he ran it himself: "I did actually run one experiment with the LaMDA system uh with someone who claims to have telepathic abilities." He tells it while arguing that such a machine may be a kind of alien mind, which is why a link between it and a human mind would matter.
